title: Hill at Hatshepsut's mortuary temple 5,300 m from Karnak's obelisks

tellings.quote: surrounding the Hacheps Mortuary is another one of these white horse hills. Exactly 5,300 m away from the obelisks within the Carnac Temple.

plain: Near the mortuary temple of the Egyptian queen Hatshepsut, a temple built for her funeral cult across the river from Luxor, there is said to be a hill sitting "exactly 5,300 m away from the obelisks" in the Karnak temple. Geoffrey Drumm, who studies the pyramids, tells Michels this without citing a source. He calls it "another one of these white horse hills" and doesn't say on the show what he means by that. If the distance is exact, it would suggest the ancient sites were laid out to a deliberate plan.
